reason: RTL registers every K pin in 2-entry pin skids (ot_hbm_svc_pin_skid2: valid/data/ready flops; out_v/out_data/in_r leave from flops), k_wr_done outputs and inputs are re-timed by flops, VM/WB commands land in stream pin flops, fills/fault leave from stream flops, straps land in one flop per domain. A kit pin stage cannot span the two async_gray_fifo domains and would add unpriced K-port latency.
